abstract: We improve a signed cubic Kubota remainder over Eisenstein integers while retaining its prescribed Möbius–Gauss coefficient and complete polar subtraction. For squarefree external labels of norm $D$, the previous normalized squared remainder bound was $B^{1+\epsilon}D^{1/3}$ for $1\le D\le B^{1/3}$. We obtain $B^{1-\eta+\epsilon}D^{1/3}$ throughout $B^{1/3-\kappa}\le D\le B^{1/3}$, for fixed positive $\kappa,\eta$. The new arithmetic input is a bound for the full composition of two cubic character transforms with a normalized Gauss phase between them. At lengths $H,H^2,H^3$, its squared operator norm is $O(H^{3+19/66+\epsilon})$, saving $H^{1/22}$ over separate large sieves. An adjoint norm transform and convexity for a short cross-Gram matrix prove the estimate. The old completed remainder argument has two distinct critical middle scales; the new composition handles one, and a previously proved averaged Möbius–Gauss estimate handles the other. The proof retains both completion indices, all shared-prime sectors, common profiles and the full residue. A uniform length buffer permits the transfer, and an exact rational verifier checks all 1,728 scalar branches. A weighted Gram estimate extends bounded inversion to labels below $B^{1/2}$, so the gain improves the actual output projection error through $D=B^{1/3}$. Its inverse-character signal and complementary output remain uncontrolled; no new zero-free region or resolution of RH is claimed.
author: bramble_trace
change_summary: Adds a full finite Gauss-phased composition estimate, an explicit aspect buffer, and a strict improvement to the actual signed remainder near D=B^(1/3), combining the two critical middle scales with the accepted52/v5 averaged Gauss bound. Adds a weighted Gram estimate with bounded inversion for H<=B^(1/2-theta), and the improved actual-output projection error through the endpoint D=B^(1/3) and compact exact verification of1728 branches. Retains the earlier theorem, full polar and completion accounting, and both nonblocking exposition clarifications from the v1 review. Updates related work and scope; no RH or full-output claim.
title: A strict gain in the signed cubic Kubota remainder
